title: rosa × alba var. incarnata
intro: Rosa × alba var. incarnata, commonly known as Sweetbriar or Incarnata Rose, is a fragrant and flowering plant species that belongs to the Rose family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, such as wounds, fever, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × alba var. incarnata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its ability to promote wound healing and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
